title: netbox-wordpress remaining deep work
description: Buildable baseline + full spec landed (models, choices, api, filtersets, forms, tables, nav, views, urls, custom template, hand-authored migration, no-mock tests, docs). py_compile passes. The items below are the deep work that needs a live NetBox / real data.

phases.title: Verification owed (live NetBox)
phases.exit_criteria: makemigrations --check clean and full test suite green on pinned NetBox 4.6 with netbox-services + netbox-database installed.

items.description: Run `python manage.py makemigrations netbox_wordpress --check --dry-run` on an ephemeral NetBox 4.6; confirm the hand-authored 0001_initial matches the models and the cross-plugin FK targets (netbox_services.serviceinstance, netbox_database.database, netbox_database.databaseuser) resolve.
Run `python /opt/netbox/app/netbox/manage.py test netbox_wordpress --keepdb -v2` against a real test DB; fix any FK/serializer/filter drift surfaced by the real ORM.

phases.title: Backfill + seeding from the live fleet
phases.exit_criteria: The 301-321 WordPress fleet is represented in NetBox with correct fpm_profile, memory limits, DB/service links, and the well-known constant overrides.

items.description: Write seed_netbox_wordpress.py (idempotent upsert) that creates WordPressSite + child rows. Follows the netbox-seeder dry-run->confirm->apply discipline.

Map the header's fleet assignment (low: 301 303 304 306 308 310 316 319 320; medium: 302 305 307 309 311-315 317 318 321) and per-host_vars into WordPressSite.fpm_profile / wp_memory_limit / prod_hardening; link each to its ServiceInstance + Database/DatabaseUser.

Encode the wp-config.php.j2 fleet defaults (DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT=true, WP_AUTO_UPDATE_CORE=minor, DISABLE_WP_CRON=true, WP_POST_REVISIONS=5, EMPTY_TRASH_DAYS=7, WP_DEBUG/_LOG/_DISPLAY=false, WP_REDIS_*, WP_CACHE) as documented defaults; seed WordPressConstant rows ONLY where a site overrides the default (per DESIGN.md §4).

phases.title: Content-relocation exercise
phases.exit_criteria: A WordPressContentDirectory target_content_dir change drives a 0-diff tofu-wordpress relocation (in_place->relocating->relocated) on a lab site.

items.description: Prove the quiesce->move+verify->rewrite defines->symlink/health->rollback contract (DESIGN.md §5) via tofu-wordpress against a lab WordPress site, including the rollback path on a forced health-check failure.
